# Pale Blue Nexus

Making sense of the future, from right here.

## About

Pale Blue Nexus is a podcast by Yohann Calpu, co-founder of Aloomii. It features conversations with operators, founders, and investors at the frontier of AI, space, and emerging tech.

## Host

Yohann Calpu — Host of Pale Blue Nexus, Co-founder of Aloomii.

## Podcast RSS

https://api.riverside.com/hosting/XLo1YoIr.rss

### Episode 01: Jim Rogers
Co-founder of the Quantum Fund with George Soros. Returned 4,200% over ten years. Wrote Investment Biker and Adventure Capitalist after traveling through 116 countries. Now based in Singapore, still investing globally.

- **Title:** Legendary investor. Co-founder of the Quantum Fund with George Soros. The man who went around the world twice on a motorcycle and a car.

### Episode 02: Jack Couch
Founder of Sophtron, building the open financial internet. Former Global VP of Payments at Xero. Founded Monchilla (acquired by Xero) and DeepIntel Solutions. A distribution operator who believes podcasts are the last channel where trust compounds.

- **Title:** Founder of Sophtron. The man building the open financial internet. On why sales is dead and podcasts are the new trust machine.

### Episode 04: Nikola Borisov

### Episode 05: Nectarios Economakis
Twenty years inside the Canadian tech ecosystem. First BD hire at Google Montreal, where he helped drive 50% year-over-year growth from 2011. Co-founded The PNR. Now Partner at Amiral Ventures, an early-stage and growth venture fund based in Montreal.

- **Title:** Inside a New $40M Fund Built to Fix Canada's Brain Drain

### Episode 06: Charles Cormier
Founder and CEO of TopLeads. Builds AI-leveraged go-to-market and sales systems, and writes about how small teams compound output with AI rather than replacing the humans behind it.

### Episode 07: Eliza Blank
Thirteen years building The Sill, the houseplant company that put 'plant parent' into the cultural vocabulary. Twelve stores, $25M raised, exited in 2024. Now CEO of The Farmlink Project, which moved 150 million pounds of rescued produce in 2025.

- **Title:** The Logistics of Saving Food: Inside The Farmlink Project

### Episode 08: Haren Bhakta, CFA
Founder and CEO of Inside Ownership Index (OWN), built on the idea that companies with deep insider ownership outperform the market. A CFA charterholder who previously led product at Dapper Labs (NBA Top Shot, Flow blockchain).
